notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Herd Baloth.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
